definitions.explanation: Describes something that is noticeably great in degree or extent. Used for changes, progress, differences, or effects that stand out.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}が{著|いちじる}しい。
{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{進歩|しんぽ}は{著|いちじる}しい。
examples.english: The progress of technology is striking.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{体力|たいりょく}の{低下|ていか}が{著|いちじる}しく、{階段|かいだん}を{上|のぼ}るだけで{息|いき}が{切|き}れる。
examples.english: Recently, the decline in my physical strength has been significant — I run out of breath just climbing stairs.

notes:
{著|いちじる}しい is somewhat formal and often used in written contexts or news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著|いちじる}しい{成長|せいちょう}: remarkable growth
- {著|いちじる}しい{進歩|しんぽ}: striking progress
- {著|いちじる}しい{変化|へんか}: significant change
- {著|いちじる}しい{低下|ていか}: marked decline
- {著|いちじる}しく{増加|ぞうか}する: to increase remarkably

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {著|いちじる}しい: remarkable, significant (formal, emphasizes degree)
- {目立|めだ}つ: conspicuous, noticeable (neutral, visual emphasis)
- すごい: amazing (casual, general intensifier)
